summary: Iteration 119 tested shop enrichment: Shop link in navbar (desktop+mobile), AI Vision Blox recategorization, enriched PDP with gallery/video/includes/rich description, bare product graceful hiding, SEO regression, and backend _merge_product new fields. 24/26 UI assertions passed; backend 4/4 pytest passed. Core features working — PDP correctly shows 4 thumbs, YouTube iframe with D5ngdbvLMC4, 9 includes rows, bold + bullets in description with no <script>. Bare product PDP hides all empty sections. Canonical/robots/JSON-LD intact. Two minor issues found: (1) /shop category tile shows 64 ITEMS for Individual Components instead of spec'd 61; (2) 'Competition Kits' tile description still lists 'AI Vision' in its blurb copy even though the product moved to Individual Components.

issues: Individual Components tile shows '64 ITEMS' — spec expected 61. Likely frontend/shopCategories bucketing is wider than spec anticipated.

Competition Kits & Advanced Kits tile description still reads 'RoboSumo, RoboRacer, Drone, Aeromodel, 3D Pen, AI Vision' — the 'AI Vision' phrase is stale copy since AI Vision Blox was moved to Individual Components.

action_items: Review Individual Components count: expected 61 but frontend tile shows 64. Verify shopCategories.js bucketing / API filter is correct, or update the spec expectation.

Update the Competition Kits & Advanced Kits category tile description (in frontend/src/utils/shopCategories.js or wherever the tile.description is defined) to remove the 'AI Vision' mention so the tile copy matches its actual contents.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/shop.py:_merge_product correctly normalises malformed includes rows (dicts without name are skipped, strings are accepted, non-list input yields []). Robust.
frontend/src/utils/richContent.js mdToHtml escapes HTML before re-introducing markdown-generated tags — verified no <script> leaks. Good.
shop.py:_fetch_vendor_catalog has 5-min cache; _VENDOR_CACHE['ts']=0 invalidation on admin override update is correct.
Hero image is forced to gallery[0] which guarantees gallery has >=1 element even if vendor sends no images; good defensive logic.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (24/26 UI assertions; 2 are minor copy/count issues)

seed_data_creation: None — override on Robo Sumo was pre-seeded by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enriched PDP contract via data-testid is now stable: pdp-gallery-thumbs, pdp-gallery-thumb-N, pdp-video, pdp-includes, pdp-includes-row-N, pdp-description-html. Robo Sumo kit (vendor_id 22b5228a) is the live reference for enriched case; any Blox/motor is the bare case. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter119_shop_enrichment.py is pytest-ready for regression. The two open items (components count=64 vs spec 61, 'AI Vision' still in competition tile blurb) are copy/count tweaks — main agent can resolve in a one-line change each.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Minor count discrepancy likely stems from frontend shopCategories.js bucketing more SKUs into Individual Components than the spec anticipated after AI Vision Blox was moved; stale blurb text is a simple copy update.
